notes: layout-05 is the default template's 'Comparison': title idx 0, body idx 1, obj idx 2, body idx 3,
obj idx 4, plus dt/ftr/sldNum. It is the only layout on this master with two zones of the same
type, which is exactly what forces the emitter to locate a placeholder shape by idx and not by type.
Overlap is measured as the share of the TEXT element's box that lies inside the zone (Box.overlap_fraction).
The default template's placeholders are laid out for a 960 px canvas, so x > 912 is free space on
this 1280 px canvas — the group sits there and must map to nothing.
No subtitle case here: this layout has no subTitle zone. subtitle -> subTitle is covered by
sizes-4x3.html on the Title Slide layout.

gateMaxPx2 188 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 128 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
